name: review-router-video
description: Launch reel for review-router: Remotion scenes plus a soundtrack synthesized in code.

scripts.render: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts Reel out/review-router.mp4 --crf=16 --audio-bitrate=320k
scripts.draft: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts Reel out/draft.mp4 --scale=0.5
scripts.render-repo: uv run --with numpy scripts/music.py src/cues-repo.json music-repo.wav && remotion render src/index.ts RepoReel out/jev-engineering.mp4 --crf=16 --audio-bitrate=320k
scripts.render-launch: uv run --with numpy scripts/music.py src/cues-launch.json music-launch.wav && remotion render src/index.ts Launch out/launch.mp4 --crf=16 --audio-bitrate=320k
